build_procedure: Root supplied strictly compiled broadcast-after-v18.o and its scoped source. The source contains the current prompt-7 transport/ownership fixes transplanted into the exact captured preimage.
A private copy of build/libradios_ui.a was made under isolated/after-v18/libradios_ui-v18.a. Root object was copied as broadcast.c.o, and ar r replaced only that member in the private archive.
The final 18-case test source was strictly compiled in C11 with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror and linked against that private UI archive plus existing audio/playout/core archives.
All 18 cases ran as one GTK suite under G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings and exited successfully. The 11-case historical artifacts were kept separately and not overwritten.
limitations: This proves the scoped prompt-7 transport fixes for all 18 deterministic GTK regression scenarios. It is not a successful build or CTest claim for the shared current source tree.
The shared current source build was still blocked by an unrelated external engine/Pulse backend configure_output symbol linkage change at the time of this proof.

Other translation units are existing static archive artifacts and are not claimed to match exact current shared source revisions. Hashes identify the observed dependency artifacts; no shared archive or shared source rollback was performed.

Media library lookup/picker, deck state/transport, provider match/card state, and managed playout metadata are controlled linker boundaries. Actual Broadcast card GTK callbacks run; PCM decoding, real provider authorization, backend persistence, hardware and whole-application acceptance are outside this scoped suite.

The external library tests invoke the real new library-loaded helper after a controlled successful audio load; the separate current-source media integration call must also be verified by its owner/root.
